title: End of Certification: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) Certificates After an SR-26
content:
A Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) certificate that has received its SR-26 is terminated no earlier than its certificate end date. The comparison is made on calendar dates: the processing date must be on or after the certificate end date, with the end lag added, and that lag is 0 days. Until that date the state still treats the driver as certified. A terminated certificate is never reopened; a later requirement needs a new filing.

**Record relied on.** The certificate end date recorded on the filing.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical end date on day E):**

| Processing date | May the certificate be terminated? | State's view of the driver |
|---|---|---|
| day E less one | no | still certified |
| day E | yes (equality satisfies "on or after") | the end date has been reached |
| day E plus one | yes | the end date has passed |

**After termination.** A requirement arising after termination is answered by a new filing, never by reopening the terminated certificate.
